titleFront: The Shield Will Be Down In Moments
titleBack: Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base!

flipToBack.timing: Required after-trigger on the blown-away event (isBlownAwayLastStep), NOT isTableChanged.
flipToBack.prose: Flip when Main Power Generators is 'blown away' (last step of the blown-away process). Single event condition; no board-count threshold.

children.req: timing trigger: Main Power Generators blown away (last step)

flipToFront.timing: NEVER flips back. Back has a hard-lose instead: PLACED OUT OF PLAY on isTableChanged if the occupation condition fails.
flipToFront.prose: No FlipCardEffect on the back. Required after-trigger: on isTableChanged, if canBePlacedOutOfPlay and you can NOT spot a Hoth site that you occupy with (piloted AT-AT OR Imperial leader OR snowtrooper), the objective is placed out of play.

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: pure blown-away event on an exact-title location (Title.Main_Power_Generators, exact match true); external engine (Target The Main Generator epic event) causes it - objective only listens

back hard-lose: OCCUPY-with semantics - need >=1 Hoth SITE occupied with piloted AT-AT (Filters.and(Filters.AT_AT, Filters.piloted)) or Imperial leader or snowtrooper; checked via canSpot on Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, ...)) with INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE
no flip-back exists: once flipped, the only failure mode is out-of-play loss of the objective
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.AT_AT, Filters.piloted), Filters.Imperial_leader, Filters.snowtrooper))) (hard-lose guard)
setup: Filters.Fifth_Marker; Filters.and(Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_17, Filters.Fourth_Marker); Filters.First_Marker; Filters.and(Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_9, Filters.Prepare_For_A_Surface_Attack)

restrictions: Filters.or(Filters.Rebel_Base_Occupation, Filters.Sunsdown, Filters.and(Filters.Dark_Jedi, Filters.not(Filters.Vader))) may not deploy; Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.AT_AT_Cannon) may not fire during your control phase; Filters.title("Echo Base Sensors") game text canceled

back: Filters.snowtrooper (download); Filters.Imperial_leader (attrition evaluator + destiny-tax none here); Filters.or(Filters.title("Rebel Leadership"), Filters.Were_Doomed) become Lost Interrupts; Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_location, Filters.controls(playerId)) (peek X)

Front, once per turn: deploy a Hoth location from Reserve Deck (THE_SHIELD_WILL_BE_DOWN_IN_MOMENTS__DOWNLOAD_HOTH_LOCATION) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set222/dark/Card222_014.java:115-133]

Back, once per turn: deploy a snowtrooper from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (IMPERIAL_TROOPS_HAVE_ENTERED_THE_BASE__DEPLOY_SNOWTROOPER) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set222/dark/Card222_014_BACK.java:105-121]

Back, once per YOUR control phase (shared action id, choose one): retrieve bottom card of Lost Pile into hand OR peek at top X cards of opponent's Reserve Deck (X = Hoth locations you control) and replace in any order [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set222/dark/Card222_014_BACK.java:67-102]

Back modifiers: attrition against opponent +1 per Imperial leader in battle; Rebel Leadership and We're Doomed are Lost Interrupts [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set222/dark/Card222_014_BACK.java:52-60]
